title: Create a model with an attribute-rule tier, save persists it, and the drawer renders the rule
verifies: the editor builds a rule on a non-default tier, save round-trips it through the API, and the pricing drawer renders the rule line

title: Test-Match resolves a winning rule tier from span attributes
verifies: the Test-Match dialog sends span attributes to /llm/models/test and shows the winning rule tier's rule line

title: Saved rules prefill, operator swap flips values to threshold, and re-save persists
verifies: saved rules hydrate into the editor, a numeric operator swaps the values input for the threshold input, and re-save persists the changed rule

title: Rule validation blocks save: empty keys required and presence-op-on-usage forbidden
verifies: empty rule keys surface a required error and a presence operator on a usage. key surfaces the forbidden error, both blocking save

title: Two identical rule tiers with equal priority show the ambiguous-tier warning
verifies: two non-default tiers with identical rules and equal priority render the ambiguous-tier tie warning

title: Add-rule button is disabled at the 8-rule cap
verifies: the add-rule button becomes disabled once a tier holds 8 rules
